data.one_liner: Ready-made animated login and sign up screen for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fully responsive animated screen for both web and mobile apps, handling login, sign up, form validation, social logins, and custom themes out of the box.
use_when: You need a quick, beautiful, and animated login and signup flow.
You want a responsive authentication screen that works well on both mobile and web views.
avoid_when: You require a completely custom authentication layout that doesn't fit standard form/welcome card split patterns.
You need backend-specific authentication widgets tied directly to a specific provider like Firebase.
strengths: Fully responsive design for desktop/web and mobile.
Extensive customization options for themes, texts, validators, and social logins.
weaknesses: Limited to login and signup flows.
Requires manual platform-specific URL launcher configurations if utilizing privacy policy or terms links.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding URL launcher scheme configurations in Info.plist (iOS) and AndroidManifest.xml (Android) if using privacy policy or terms links.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedLogin(
  onLogin: (LoginData loginData) async => null,
  onSignup: (SignUpData signupData) async => null,
  socialLogins: const [],
)
